title: Hardware Configuration Inconsistent: Startup Inhibit 0x2521
description: After a hardware replacement in Cabinet 3, the CPU refuses to enter RUN mode. Diagnostic buffer reports 'Pending startup inhibit: HW configuration inconsistent (TIA portal activity).' The physical unit is marked V4.4, but the offline project is configured for V4.2. Per manual section 6.5, the device type must be changed in the device configuration to match the physical MLFB 6ES7 214-1AG40-0XB0.[3]

title: Modbus TCP Timeout: MB_CLIENT Status 80C8
description: The communication with the remote power meter (IP: 192.168.0.50) has failed. The MB_CLIENT instruction returns error code 80C8. Network ping is successful from the engineering laptop.

title: ET 200SP Station Failure: Potential Group Configuration Error
description: Slot 4 on the distributed I/O rack is not receiving power. Diagnostic buffer reports 'Hardware component not available due to a parameter assignment error'.
resolution_summary: Enabled 'New Potential Group' in TIA Portal hardware config for Slot 4 to match the light-colored BaseUnit installation.

title: TMAIL_C: DNS Resolution Failure 80D3
description: Automated production reports via email are failing. The TMAIL_C instruction block returns status 80D3 when using the MailServerAddress 'smtp.office365.com'.
resolution_summary: Configured the DNS server IP (8.8.8.8) and Gateway IP in the CPU hardware properties under TIA Portal.

title: Cycle Time Violation: OB 80 Triggered by Heavy Math
description: The PLC intermittently enters STOP mode with a cycle time overflow. Diagnostic buffer shows 'Maximum cycle time exceeded'. Current limit is set to 150ms.
resolution_summary: the cpu entered stop mode because the user program execution time exceeded the configured 150ms cycle monitoring time. to fix this, optimize the program code to reduce scan time, distribute heavy processing over several cycles, or increase the maximum cycle time in the cpu hardware properties. if ob 80 is not present or the overflow occurs twice, the cpu will stop by default.

title: OPC UA: BadCertificateUriInvalid Error on Connect
description: SCADA client cannot establish a secure connection to the PLC OPC UA server. Client logs report 'BadCertificateUriInvalid'.
resolution_summary: the opc ua connection failed with 'badcertificateuriinvalid' because the application uri or subject alternative name (san) in the plc's server certificate did not match the endpoint used by the scada client, likely due to nat. the resolution is to update the cpu hardware configuration in tia portal to include the correct external ip/hostname in the certificate settings, re-generate the certificate, and re-deploy to the plc.

title: SM 1231 AI: Wire Break Detected 0xA202
description: Analog input channel 0 for the pressure transmitter is reporting 32767. Diagnostic LED (MAINT) is solid yellow.
resolution_summary: the analog input channel reported a wire break (0xA202) and an overflow value of 32767 because the current loop was interrupted. the ground truth resolution is to inspect and secure all wiring terminals between the sensor and the plc, verify the sensor's power supply, and ensure the loop current is within the 4-20 ma range. tightening loose connections or replacing damaged cables resolves the diagnostic interrupt.

title: Motion Control: ErrorID 16#8001 Low SW Limit
description: Axis_1 (Linear Slider) faulted during positioning. MC_MoveAbsolute returns Error=TRUE and ErrorID=16#8001.
resolution_summary: the motion control error 16#8001 occurred because the axis reached the lower software limit switch during a move operation. the ground truth resolution is to verify the target position at the mc_moveabsolute instruction, ensure the axis technology object configuration has the correct software limit values, and perform an mc_reset followed by an mc_home if necessary to synchronize the coordinate system.

title: ALM Connection Failure: Software Startup Blocked
description: TIA Portal V16 refuses to launch on Engineer Workstation 2. Error message: 'Automation License Manager could not connect to server'.
resolution_summary: the connection failure to the automation license manager (alm) occurred because the alm background service was not running or port 4410 was blocked. the ground truth resolution is to set the 'automation license manager' service to 'automatic' and 'start' it via windows services. additionally, verify that firewall settings allow communication for almservice.exe to ensure tia portal can validate licenses during software startup.

title: Memory Overload: Program Card vs Load Memory
description: Compile fails with 'Insufficient load memory on the target' despite using a 4MB program card.
resolution_summary: the 'insufficient load memory' error occurs when the project size exceeds the internal load memory of the cpu, as the system does not automatically overflow into the 4mb program card without proper configuration. the ground truth resolution is to perform a full software rebuild to optimize the project size, verify the memory card is set as a program card to replace internal load memory, and ensure the total number of blocks remains within the cpu-specific hardware limits.
